name: blossom-assistant
description: Local coding assistant for VS Code via Blossom ChatRouter (or Ollama).

blossom.backend.description: LLM backend. 'chatRouter' = Blossom ChatRouter (OpenAI-compatible on :8081). 'ollama' = native Ollama /api/chat.

blossom.api.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the LLM API. ChatRouter default: http://127.0.0.1:8081. Ollama: http://localhost:11434.

blossom.models.coding.description: Model id sent in requests (ChatRouter mostly routes by message content).

blossom.models.rp.description: Deprecated — plugin is coding-only. Kept for older settings.

blossom.models.japanese.description: Deprecated — plugin is coding-only. Kept for older settings.

blossom.persona.model.description: Ollama model when persona.source is ollama. Empty = models.coding.

blossom.persona.systemPrompt.description: Optional extra instructions. Leave empty when using ChatRouter.

blossom.ui.displayName.description: Display name shown in the chat header and panel tab.

blossom.ui.iconPath.description: Path to a custom icon image (PNG/JPG/SVG/WebP). Absolute path or workspace-relative (e.g. assets/my-icon.png). Empty = built-in cherry blossom.

blossom.gemini.model.description: Gemini model for confirm-gated Blossom escalations.

blossom.claude.model.description: Claude model for confirm-gated Blossom escalations.

blossom.claude.inputPricePer1M.description: Estimated USD per 1M input tokens (spend tracker).

blossom.claude.outputPricePer1M.description: Estimated USD per 1M output tokens (spend tracker).

blossom.edits.autoApply.description: When true (default), Blossom writes proposed file creates/edits to disk automatically (no Apply click). Toggle per-session with the Auto-apply chip or by saying 'auto-apply' / 'stop auto-apply'.

blossom.edits.autoSave.description: After Apply or Auto-apply, save the file to disk immediately (no extra Ctrl+S).

blossom.edits.contentGuard.description: When true (default), block Apply/auto-apply that would replace executable source with README/markdown prose, or gut a code file without preserving imports/functions. Lets auto-apply stay on for real code revisions.

blossom.edits.dryRunGate.description: When true (default), block Apply/auto-apply on patch_*.py, deploy_*.py, and tools/*.py until run_command succeeds with --dry-run (or a python -c smoke import) for that script in the same turn.

blossom.edits.openDiffOnReplace.description: When true (default), open a side-by-side vscode.diff (before/after) as each search_replace lands, in addition to the PR-style diff card in chat.

blossom.commands.askBeforeRun.description: When true (default), Blossom pauses and asks before running shell commands (run_command). Use Run / Always allow / Deny in chat. Turn off via the Fast mode button in the chat input to auto-run commands.

blossom.commands.allowlist.description: Shell commands that skip the Run prompt. Use a first token (e.g. ls, git), an exact command, or a prefix with * (e.g. git status*). Always allow in chat adds the first token. Defaults allow Python probes/scratch scripts.

blossom.agent.toolProfile.description: Tool catalog injected into coding prompts. auto = tiny→minimal, plan→research, full→full (aliases omitted from catalog).

blossom.agent.toolResultMaxChars.description: Max characters for the latest tool result kept in the agent transcript (run_command/search/read compaction).

blossom.agent.maxToolRounds.description: Hard cap on agent tool rounds per turn.

blossom.agent.stepMode.description: HITL gates: off (default), confirmTools (pause every N tool rounds), planSteps (pause after write/delete tools so you can review diffs).

blossom.agent.confirmToolsAfterRounds.description: When blossom.agent.stepMode is confirmTools, pause for Continue/Stop after this many tool rounds.

blossom.siblingPeek.enabled.description: Allow read-only peek into related sibling folders.

blossom.siblingPeek.maxFiles.description: Max entries from a related-folder listing.

blossom.siblingPeek.maxBytes.description: Max bytes read from a related-folder file.

blossom.cursor.enabled.description: Allow ESCALATE_CURSOR → Cursor SDK agent (uses Cursor subscription). Off by default — use local tools + optional Gemini/Claude text escalate.

blossom.cursor.model.description: Cursor SDK model id for escalations.

blossom.handoff.maxSummaryChars.description: Max chars for compressed session summary before cloud escalate.

blossom.handoff.summarizeThresholdChars.description: Raw history above this triggers LLM summarize before cloud escalate.

blossom.escalate.fallbackOrder.description: When one provider fails/declined, offer next with same compressed handoff.

blossom.escalate.fallbackEnabled.description: Try next provider in fallbackOrder after decline/failure.

blossom.escalate.askFirst.description: Before any cloud call (ChatRouter auto-fallback or local ESCALATE_* markers), show a picker: Gemini / Claude / stay local (Cursor only if blossom.cursor.enabled).

blossom.escalate.applyFromCloud.description: After a cloud escalation answer, parse path= code fences into Apply cards (same as local Blossom).

blossom.vision.onAttach.description: When images are attached: local-caption runs offline Ollama VL (+ optional OCR) and injects [IMAGE CAPTION] for the local coder (default). metadata-only = dimensions/RGB only. escalate = Cursor/cloud path (not offline-first).

blossom.vision.caption.enabled.description: Run local vision caption when onAttach is local-caption.

blossom.vision.caption.model.description: Ollama multimodal model tag for offline image captioning (e.g. moondream, llava, qwen2-vl).

blossom.vision.caption.ollamaBaseUrl.description: Local Ollama base URL used only for vision captioning (can differ from ChatRouter coding URL).

blossom.vision.caption.timeoutMs.description: Timeout for one local VL caption call.

blossom.vision.caption.ocrFallback.description: If Ollama VL fails, try local Tesseract OCR (with optional Pillow invert preprocess).

blossom.vision.caption.ocrCommand.description: OCR executable on PATH (or absolute path).

blossom.vision.caption.maxImages.description: Max images to caption per turn.

blossom.deescalate.enabled.description: After a cloud escalation answer, offer Retry with local Blossom (uses cloud text as read-only reference).

blossom.ghidra.enabled.description: Enable read_ghidra tool (HTTP bridge to Ghidra MCP plugin).

blossom.ghidra.baseUrl.description: Ghidra HTTP bridge URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8089). Empty = auto-discover on localhost ports.

blossom.ghidra.autoDiscover.description: Probe localhost ports for Ghidra MCP HTTP bridge when baseUrl is empty.

blossom.ghidra.discoveryPorts.description: Ports to probe for Ghidra HTTP bridge (blossom.ghidra.autoDiscover).

blossom.ghidra.cacheTtlMs.description: How long to cache Ghidra connection discovery (ms).

blossom.ghidra.transport.description: Ghidra integration: HTTP read_ghidra, stdio MCP ghidra_mcp, or both.

blossom.ghidra.mcp.enabled.description: Enable local Ghidra MCP bridge (stdio) via ghidra_mcp tool — no Cursor tokens.

blossom.ghidra.mcp.command.description: Python executable for bridge_mcp_ghidra.py. Empty = read ~/.cursor/mcp.json ghidra server.

blossom.ghidra.mcp.args.description: Args for MCP bridge (typically path to bridge_mcp_ghidra.py).

blossom.ghidra.mcp.toolAllowlist.description: MCP tools the local model may call (empty = safe default set). Add names as needed.
